title: Scripture and Discernment
definition: Scripture and discernment belong together because God's Word trains believers to distinguish truth from error, wisdom from folly, and righteousness from sin.
summary: Discernment grows as believers are trained by the truth of Scripture.
christFocus: Jesus is the truth, and His Word helps His sheep recognize His voice and reject deception.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Discernment is not suspicion or pride. It is the ability to evaluate teaching, desires, influences, and decisions by God's Word.

Scripture trains the mind and heart to recognize what is true, good, and faithful. It exposes error that may sound spiritual but leads away from Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people mistake confidence, popularity, or emotion for truth. Scripture and discernment matters because deception often looks attractive before it becomes destructive.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Test what you hear by Scripture. Ask whether it agrees with the Gospel, honors Christ, bears godly fruit, and leads to faithful obedience.
